Enabled financial inclusion for 8M unbanked adults

cards.title: Public Financial Management Reform
cards.description: Restructured fiscal governance systems improving transparency and reducing leakages by 35%.

cards.title: Universal Health Coverage Strategy
cards.description: Designed financing and delivery model extending primary care to 12M rural residents.

cards.title: Education System Modernization
cards.description: Led curriculum reform and teacher training program impacting 2.5M students across 8 provinces.

cards.title: Climate Resilience Investment Plan
cards.description: Structured a $800M climate adaptation fund with blended finance from MDBs and private capital.

adviseData.title: Shaping Institutions, Driving Reform
adviseData.description: Long-term advisory partnerships that transform institutional capacity, governance frameworks, and policy delivery systems at national scale.

cards.title: Central Bank Governance Overhaul
cards.quote: Restructured monetary policy frameworks and board governance, restoring credibility and attracting $1.2B in foreign reserves within two years.

cards.title: Civil Service Modernization Program
cards.quote: Redesigned recruitment, performance, and promotion systems for 120,000 civil servants, reducing vacancy rates by 45%.

cards.title: Anti-Corruption Institutional Framework
cards.quote: Established independent oversight bodies and digital procurement systems that recovered $340M in misallocated public funds.

cards.title: Sub-National Governance Reform

cards.title: Judicial Efficiency & Access Initiative
cards.quote: Digitized case management and trained 800 judicial officers, reducing case backlog by 52%.
